steps.text: Plug the included Ethernet cable into an open LAN port on your router.
Plug the other end of the Ethernet cable into SmartLinc's Ethernet jack.
Plug SmartLinc into an unswitched AC outlet.
steps.expect: Status LED turns on dim, solid white

steps.text: Verify the connection between SmartLinc and the router.
steps.expect: The router port's LED turns on and SmartLinc's Ethernet jack LED turns on green

steps.text: If you use the Insteon app, launch it on your smartphone or tablet and follow the on-screen instructions to configure SmartLinc; otherwise set it up with its web-based interface.

notes: Don't plug SmartLinc into a switched outlet, a filtered power strip or an AC line filter, and don't plug Insteon modules into one another.

steps.text: In SmartLinc's web interface, click the room of the responder you want to control, then click the scene you want to add it to.
Next to Scene Devices, click Add.
steps.expect: The Add/Remove Status box displays Waiting...

steps.text: Press and hold the responder's SET button for 3 seconds.
steps.expect: The Add/Remove Status box displays Done

steps.text: Test the link by clicking the On and Off buttons next to Test Scene.

notes: The Central Controller 2412N Owner's Manual links SmartLinc only as a controller of other Insteon devices, from its web interface or the Insteon app.

steps.text: In SmartLinc's web interface, click the room of the responder you want to remove, then click the scene it is in.
Next to Scene Devices, click Remove.
steps.expect: The Add/Remove Status box displays Waiting...

steps.text: Press and hold the responder's SET button for 3 seconds.
steps.expect: The Add/Remove Status box displays Done

steps.text: Confirm the link was removed by clicking the On and Off buttons next to Test Scene.
Unplug SmartLinc and wait about 10 seconds.
Press and hold SmartLinc's SET button and, while holding it, plug SmartLinc back in.
When the beep stops, release the SET button.
steps.expect: Status LED turns off, then turns back on solid

notes: If you don't remove all links first, previously linked responders retry communications and cause network delays.

A Connection Reset (press and hold the SET button for 5 seconds until the status LED blinks, then tap it five times until the LED turns on solid) re-enables DHCP, resets the port and disables authentication while keeping links and names.

steps.text: Unlink all devices from SmartLinc, then factory reset it.
